planning.scope: Standalone process teaching: purpose, quantity/unit headings, paired raw records, construction and checking. Exact fictional motion data, true repeats and zero. No unit conversions/speed calculation or instrument proficiency required.
planning.evidenceLimits: Given-data table construction is supported partial process evidence only. Does not establish physical measurement, experiment design, uncertainty judgement, independent complete process or unsupported formal game credit.
planning.assumed: Only canonical required groups. Given category/quantity/unit examples support response; adult reading allowed; no object naming/speech/count-tap prerequisite.
coTaught: Column conventions and retrieving a paired entry are taught in place; M-DATA05 family support is not a new hard prerequisite.
Fictional observation/model clock is given; no speed formula or unit-conversion requirement.
planning.assetProvenance: Original math/data SVGs; unchanged supplied shared PNG. XML and actual image decoding required, no HTML-only decode assumption.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Graph source_basis/role/relations are inherited frozen facts. Counts, model time, interface and record formats are project design, not a curriculum mandate.

extensions.evidencePolicy: No personal history, storage, formal unsupported game credit, independence/retention/efficacy claim.
extensions.lifecycle: Standalone module only; pause freezes native controls, reset preserves pause, dispose removes listener/frame ownership.
extensions.modelVsPractice: Model illustration is independent guidance, not a blind feedback-clear event.
extensions.timing: One playback second equals one model second, step1s; exact fictional samples from the same trajectory.
